subject: Earlier Sky Lagoon object animations
question: Do the existing Sky Lagoon v3 object animations (and earlier layers/objects) already cover the alive-painting work?
decision: The owner answered: the objects "never passed audit due to flaws in ltx 2.5 workflows not producing quality products". The v3 objects and their predecessors are not a runtime source; new whole-drawing frames need a different, piloted method.
